Evidence: The sleeping position clip ran 13 Aug for 1865 views and 28 Aug for 1590. 15 days apart, 15 percent worse. 15 days is too close.
Both runs used the same caption. If the clip repeats, the caption should not.
A repost that clears 80 percent is still working. Below that, retire the clip rather than space it further.
Two runs under 80 percent means the clip is spent, not badly timed.
37 exact duplicates were sitting in a 200 slot cap on 01 Sep 2026. Reposting is fine. Queueing the same caption 5 times is not.
